content:
mina: kicking off a short micro-freeze for the v3.8 incremental launch. window: 20m starting now. goal: warmup canary, run quick smoke, and validate unpin criteria. tagging owners @carlos @tara.
carlos: I	m on rollout watch. preflight summary: canary image baked, infra quotas checked, feature flag `v3_8_pending` set false by default. logs from staging look clean.
tara: I'll take alerts/metrics. My triggers: sustained 4xx/5xx >3% for 2m OR median p95 latency >1.8x baseline for 3m -> escalate to rollback.
deploy-bot: Preflight OK: tests: unit pass, smoke pass, canary task spun. Canary slice set to 8% -> ramp plan ready.
mina: Plan: pin model-serving -> `v3.8-hotfix-1` for 20m, ramp canary to 30% over 6m, then decide. If stable for 10m post-ramp we unpin. Carlos will author rollback if needed.
carlos: Pin applying now. commit: a1b2c3d. Pin noted in deploy-log.
release-bot: Action logged: pin model-serving to v3.8-hotfix-1 by carlos at 2777778902.
infra: quick ops snippet for rollback (copy):
```
# fallback
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/model-serving model=registry.redwood/model:v3.7-stable
kubectl rollout status deploy/model-serving --timeout=120s
opsctl cache flush --service=model-serving
```
oncall: standing by. I have the runbook open and will execute rollback if triggers hit. Notify #incidents automatically on rollback.
tara: Metrics look steady so far. slight memory climb on one canary pod, but within expected headroom.
deploy-bot: Canary ramp to 30% complete at 2777778960. No alert rules fired.
mina: Good. Hold for 10m observation. Reminder: if KMS errors surface (seen last week) we abort immediately.
carlos: rolling to full traffic will be a manual step after hold. I'll also prepare a quick unpin command:
```
# unpin shorthand
deploy-bot unpin model-serving && echo "unpinned"
```
release-bot: Event: canary ramp finished, no anomalies at 2777778960.
oncall: still tailing logs, no auth or 5xx pattern yet.
tara: p95 latency trending +8% but p99 flat. holding.
mina: OK team, after the 10m hold if stable we unpin. leaving micro-freeze open for another 10m. thanks. :raised_hands:
carlos: noted, will prepare tag and update release notes with the micro-freeze summary.
release-bot: Final: model-serving unpinned at 2777779010 by carlos. Micro-freeze closed, no rollback executed. Postmortem: none needed; follow-up: update docs for KMS retry logic.
mina: nice and smooth. closing the window.
